name: Avatar · image · mask · idol
description: The authored ecology in sequence: presence becoming addressable, the image gathering force, the mask's passage into self-administration, the idol's closure, the counterfeit and the liar's dividend, and regard returning through the form.

text.kicker: #0–#1 · the four-office ecology; A28 authored ground and positional delegation
text.title: Presence becomes addressable through a form
text.italic: The avatar embodies effective finite presence: not made unreal by having an appearance, but given an occasion on which it can matter — authority exact without becoming absolute sourcehood.

text.body: Presence becomes addressable through a form. A face turns towards someone; a name lets that person be called again; a role gives an undertaking a recognisable place. Someone can now be met, remembered, trusted, opposed or answered. A person does not first become complete in isolation and then add a public mask — language, expression and shared practices participate in the life that appears.

Yet no achieved presentation finishes that life: the named can answer differently; the one approached through a role can question what the role permits. Descent names the movement into a form that can act — a voice rather than every possible voice, an entrusted representative rather than an undertaking with no bearer. A28: authority exact and effective without becoming absolute sourcehood; even the original instruction is already a formulation.
Occurrences: the naming and role (#0, taken up as mask at #3); the entrusted commission (#1, returned at #5→0).

scenes.name: The image gathers force
scenes.character: Attention returns to it; desire organises around it; a picture that once expressed a situation becomes a measure for the next. The Bimba/pratibimba recursion gives real local authority.

entities.name: the image — gathering attention, desire, expectation
the organising complex — the field of response around a consequential formation
Bimba locally · pratibimba widely — authority with a determinate scope
the test — can the encountered source still alter what the image means?

text.kicker: #2 · Symbolon Dynamics; the Neumann ground; A20's authority test
text.title: The image gathers force
text.italic: The decisive change is in authority: whether the encountered source can still alter what the image is allowed to mean and do.

text.body: The image makes presence available under a particular arrangement — faithful without being exhaustive; selection gives recognition its precision. Within a declared Context Frame an achieved image can genuinely occupy Bimba, the local original, while remaining pratibimba relative to wider sources — authority real at the scale of the inquiry; idolisation begins when it prevents its own source relation from being questioned.

The image gathers force: attention returns, desire and fear organise, expectations make possibilities vivid. Symbolon Dynamics: archetypal capacity, particular image and organising complex keep different offices. Libido, prāṇa and Śakti name registers of efficacy — investment, circulation, manifestation-power — without a common physical measurement. The test: what the coherence can receive — if every encounter must confirm it, apparent fidelity protects the image from the relation that made it significant.
Occurrences: the gathered attention and valuation (#2, captured at #4); the libido/prāṇa/Śakti registers (#2); the Bimba office (#1, returned at #5→0).

text.kicker: #3 · the Prisoner appointment; the chameleon seam held for its own recovery
text.title: The mask: participation becoming self-administration
text.italic: The mask demonstrates access conditioned on presentation: what began as an interface becomes an internal criterion — the doors keep opening while the life that can pass through them narrows.

text.body: The image becomes a mask when it offers a way to enter a social field: language, manner, credentials and the expectations of a role make someone legible. Learning to wear it is participation's achievement — no demand for complete exposure. The pressure appears when access depends upon the presentation so completely that its bearer must administer life by the recognising field's measure.

The mask opens doors while narrowing the life that can pass through: anticipating what will count, the bearer can receive an unapproved response as a defect in the self. The Prisoner stages it: the agent designated Number Six, Number Two occupants, Number One the question — numbering gives the office continuity and the captive an identity the institution administers; the question about source diverted into power's classification of the questioner.

Declared cross-story: the Prisoner and Daphne and Job appointments of the quilt's ecology, each whole retaining its own home. ↳ Occurrences: the opening doors and narrowing life (#3); Six's assigned number (#3, whole at the-prisoner).

scenes.character: The bearer visible, perhaps more widely represented, while losing the ability to change the terms of the representation. Daphne's laurel; Job's protected account; the deepfake forges provenance itself.

the protected account — contradiction classified as the judged person's defect
the deepfake — a counterfeit Symbolon: body joined to utterance, source to sign, forged
the liar's dividend — counterfeiting making the genuine record refusable

text.kicker: #4 · the Ovid, Job and deepfake appointments; A18's fabricated slash; A32's next encounter
text.title: The idol closes the path through the image
text.italic: The deepfake demonstrates the closure at the claimed seam itself: not merely a false proposition but a forged provenance — and the dividend that lets a real witness be refused as synthetic.

text.body: The idol closes the path through the image: the bearer remains visible while losing the ability to change the terms of representation; contrary speech is classified as further evidence. Ovid: Daphne's refusal and Peneus's grant precede the pursuit; the changed body feels, recoils from the kiss, is claimed for Apollo's emblems — seeming assent retained, neither detail authorising consent. The emblem continues after possession has failed.

Job tests another image: an account of justice defended by making Job the guilty person it needs; the whirlwind changes the field, the friends are rebuked, restoration passes through his intercession. The deepfake forges the apparent provenance by which a proposition asks to be trusted; once fabrication is available as explanation, a real witness can be dismissed as synthetic — no prevalence or documented case established here.

Declared cross-story: the Apollo–Eros–Daphne–Peneus whole figures emblematic possession after withdrawal; the Job whole figures the witness the protected account must hear. ↳ Occurrences: the laurel's continuation (#4); the protected account (#4); the forged provenance and the dividend (#4, returned at #5→0).

withdrawal as an answer the representation must learn to receive

the four offices walk to regard (the ecology's return)

text.kicker: #5→0 · the Arbitration field at register 3; A27, A30; the Neumann relation without ego-chronology
text.title: Regard returns through the form
text.italic: The whole returns-to its consumers as Mytheme: the tellings make the relations lived and legible — and the form's integrity lies in allowing the life it carried to answer back.

text.body: Regard returns through the form to the participant who can answer it. The answer need not confirm the first question: it can disclose an omitted circumstance, refuse an imposed role, correct an attributed statement, or show that the criterion itself misnamed the encounter. Maintained personhood does not require an essence displayed without mediation; it requires that continuity of address not become ownership of the person addressed.

The Symbol/Account/Trust field carries four operations: identify the claimed source, make the claim inspectable, let reliance permit correction and refusal, return the effects to the conditions of next use. An avatar remains powerful with its source office revisable; a mask enables participation while its bearer exceeds its terms; withdrawal can be the answer. A27 grounds unity without possession; A30 the shared encounter; person, image and field return still distinct.
Occurrences: the four offices' return (#0–#4, #5→0); the entrusted commission (#1, #5→0); the counterfeit's consequence for the next encounter (#4, #5→0).
